name: Google Analytics 4 (GA 4)
shortInfo: Google analytics service (GA 4) that enables you to measure traffic and engagement across your websites and apps.
brief: DataChannel’s Google Analytics 4 (GA 4)integration lets you sync data from the Google Analytics 4 API automatically into your data warehouse. Google Analytics 4 has the flexibility to measure many different kinds of data, delivering a strong analytics experience that’s designed for the future.
about:
Google Analytics 4 (GA 4) is an analytics service that enables you to measure traffic and engagement across your websites and apps. The next generation of Analytics which collects event-based data from both websites and apps. GA4 is a new property designed for the future of measurement: Collects both website and app data to better understand the customer journey.  
  
Learn more about [Google Analytics 4 API documentation](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1/basics).
availableData:
